key.description: The resource's identity, when that is not its path. Say it when you move the file: the path the resource had. It never changes.

path.description: The resource's path, when the file is kept somewhere that does not give it one.

description.description: What it is for, in plain text.

schemaSource.description: Set when `input` and `output` were read from the script's own `input` and `output` exports, which the console then shows and does not let be edited by hand.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a run may take, in seconds, before it is stopped and fails.

memoryMb.description: The most memory the script may use, in MB. Default 512. Past it, the run fails.

retries.description: What happens when a run fails: how many more tries it gets, and how long between.

limit.description: How many more times a failed run is tried. 0 tries it once.

delaySeconds.description: How long to wait before a try, in seconds.

backoff.description: Whether the wait doubles with each try.

concurrency.description: How many runs of this script may be in progress at once.

oneOf.description: How many runs of this script may be in progress at once.
How many runs of this script may be in progress at once for each value of `key`, such as one per customer. Runs with other values go ahead.

key.description: Where the value is in the input, as `input.<field>` or `input.<field>.<field>`. A run whose input has no value there shares one lane with the others that have none.

limit.description: How many runs for each value of `key` may be in progress at once.

worker.description: The worker pool this script runs on, for a script that must run in a particular place, such as inside a client's network. Without it, any worker of the default pool runs it.

uses.description: Everything the script may read at run time. Each must be bound before a deploy to production or a promotion. A deploy to a dev workspace goes ahead with a warning.

connections.description: Connections the script may use, by path.

connectionGroups.description: Connection groups the script may pick a member of at run time. Nothing has to be bound before a deploy.

secrets.description: Secrets of the workspace the script may read, by name.

variables.description: Variables the script may read, by path.

tables.description: Custom tables the script reads or writes.

sources.description: External data sources the script reads or writes.

onFailure.description: What to do when a run fails for the last time.

script.description: A script to start with the failed run as input.

notify.description: An HTTP connection to POST a summary to.

node.description: Makes the script a step that can be picked in the flow editor, under this label.

label.description: What the step is called in the flow editor.

icon.description: The name of an icon from the interface's set.

category.description: The group the step is listed under in the flow editor.

takes.description: What a flow step may hand the script with `with`: a connection, a table or an event the script does not name itself.
